title: E: scripts/run_experiment.py refuses unless results/prereg/<exp>.json is committed and not older than code; locks + posts
summary: scripts/run_experiment.py <EXP> [--modal] [--check]: refuses unless results/prereg/<EXP>.json is committed, unmodified, final with empty blocked_on, and no commit touched autoresearch/, modal_app.py or scripts/ after it; --yes for paid. Runs from runs/snapshots/<hash> (git worktree) so edits can't mix code versions; tries the live-run lock, posts start/end, writes CODE_VERSION + RUN_MANIFEST.json. Runner kinds grid|commands. tests/test_run_experiment.py (throwaway repo).
